item.title: US Marine indicted in Okinawa robbery and homicide case
item.description: A 20-year-old U.S. Marine based in Okinawa, Japan, has been indicted on murder and robbery charges.

item.title: Trump says he is weighing Iran deal against action to 'finish them off'
item.description: President Trump said he is deciding between reaching an agreement with Tehran and taking action to 'finish them off.'

item.title: 12 injured, including 6 children, in shooting near Florida university
item.description: At least 11 of those injured had gunshot wounds, police said.

item.title: Gina Hinojosa cites 'deep disappointment' in both parties
item.description: Democratic state Rep. Gina Hinojosa, running for Texas governor, said there is 'deep disappointment in both political parties.'
